image_description: A close-up portrait of an orangutan's face and upper shoulders. The subject has characteristic long, shaggy reddish-brown fur framing a broad, flat face with dark skin. The eyes are amber/brown and forward-facing. The nose is prominent with visible nostrils. The mouth is closed in a slight smile. The background is blurred, suggesting a shallow depth of field.

Ears are small and partially obscured by fur, consistent with orangutan anatomy.
